roles.label: 默认
roles.pose: two fully open round eyes, centered pupils
roles.motion: small anticipatory uplift, one soft blink, settle

roles.label: 待机
roles.pose: relaxed open eyes with slightly low pupils
roles.motion: slow float down, lazy double blink, settle

roles.label: 聆听
roles.pose: attentive open eyes looking ahead; small cyan three-bar listening pulse in the top band
roles.motion: pulse the three cyan bars in sequence while eyes stay calm

roles.label: 思考
roles.pose: uneven eyes, both pupils look up to one side
roles.motion: gaze up-left, thoughtful pause, one eye narrows, return

roles.label: 开心
roles.pose: wide eyes curve into cheerful upward crescents
roles.motion: notice, brighten, rebound in a small buoyant bounce, settle

roles.label: 突然发现
roles.pose: very round white eyes and small pupils; one lime spark between eyes
roles.motion: fast delighted widening, small rise, gentle settle

roles.label: 受惊
roles.pose: rigid tall whites, pin-point pupils, squashed gap
roles.motion: sharp recoil, hold very still for a beat, cautious recovery

roles.label: 好奇歪头
roles.pose: white eyes lean together diagonally, near eye a bit larger
roles.motion: ease into a diagonal tilt, hold two beats, straighten

roles.label: 张望
roles.pose: balanced open whites with pupils turned outward to explore
roles.motion: hold a left glance, sweep to right, center

roles.label: 眨眼
roles.pose: left eye closed as a clean white crescent; right eye wide
roles.motion: one distinct left wink, playful hold, reopen both

roles.label: 摇摆
roles.pose: two open rounded eyes offset in height
roles.motion: two rhythmic side-to-side leaning beats, mirror timing not the art

roles.label: 晕乎乎
roles.pose: wonky eye sizes, offset pupils, two tiny coral orbit marks at eye level
roles.motion: small off-balance left then right wobble; damp quickly

roles.label: 放松
roles.pose: gently half-closed eyes, broad horizontal white shapes
roles.motion: exhale-like slow lowering of lids and float back up

roles.label: 困倦
roles.pose: almost closed white eyelids, a sliver of black pupil
roles.motion: two sleepy dips, briefly almost shut, lift halfway

roles.label: 大笑
roles.pose: two tightly happy clamped white curves, compressed shapes
roles.motion: two elastic laughing pulses and a held smile-shaped eye pose

roles.label: 搞怪
roles.pose: one large stretched eye, one tiny round eye, crossed pupils
roles.motion: small left-right switch in eye scale, freeze on the silly pose

roles.label: 喜欢
roles.pose: two rounded soft white eyes with dark heart-shaped pupils
roles.motion: dark pupils round into hearts and gently pulse once

roles.label: 害羞
roles.pose: two lowered white eyes looking down sideways, tiny hot pink cheek dashes
roles.motion: quick glance away, pink dashes briefly light up, slow peek back

roles.label: 得意
roles.pose: two forward-looking white half lids, one lid slightly raised
roles.motion: brief diagonal lifting of one eye, hold the confident look

roles.label: 好吃
roles.pose: two small delighted white crescents with a tiny yellow sparkle between them
roles.motion: small anticipatory squish, open into pleased crescents, two compact beats

roles.label: 难过
roles.pose: downturned eye pairs and low gaze, gently sagging outer corners
roles.motion: slow downward droop, linger, slow partial lift

roles.label: 哭泣
roles.pose: downturned eyes with one discrete cyan tear beside one eye
roles.motion: one clear tear slips and vanishes above subtitle margin, slight tremble

roles.label: 俏皮
roles.pose: close-set eyes with both pupils pointing inward
roles.motion: pupils converge, hold, pop back apart

roles.label: 生气
roles.pose: bold angled white upper lids narrow toward the center
roles.motion: fast narrowing, brief huff-like compression, release halfway

roles.label: 插入动画
roles.pose: two white eyes with crisp square-corner scan highlights
roles.motion: short modular scan alignment, briefly hold, dissolve accents

roles.label: 看左边
roles.pose: both pupils clearly on the viewer's left
roles.motion: move both pupils from center to the viewer's left; hold; return

roles.label: 看右边
roles.pose: both pupils clearly on the viewer's right
roles.motion: move both pupils from center to the viewer's right; hold; return

roles.label: 吃东西
roles.pose: alternately squashed rounded white eyes, a single tiny acid sparkle
roles.motion: two distinct chew-like squash beats using eye shapes alone

roles.label: 疲惫
roles.pose: low, uneven drooping half-lids, centered gaze
roles.motion: heavy slow sink, hold, one effortful partial lift

coverage: 28 firmware semantics plus the synthetic listening composite
